1.explanation: This minimal React example mounts Carbon’s <NumberInput> component and reproduces the default caret‐style controls seen in the bug screenshot. We import the relevant subcomponents (NumberInputField, NumberInputStepper, NumberIncrementStepper, NumberDecrementStepper) and wire up a simple state hook so you can click the up/down carets to change the number. Rendering this code locally (ensuring you have the Carbon stylesheets imported) will exactly reproduce the narrow vertical carets control scenario described in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario: The Carbon React <NumberInput> component is rendering its default vertical up/down carets inside a narrow control container on the right side of the input. In the provided screenshot you can see the label “Number Input label” above a grey‐outlined number field showing “50,” with two tiny caret arrows (up and down) stacked vertically in a slim area to the right of the input. The original feature request was to explore alternate control options (for example, plus/minus buttons), but out of the box the component still displays only these carets.
